title: Bright Data Zone
description: A Bright Data zone is a configured proxy pool or product entitlement (residential, ISP, datacenter, mobile, Web Unlocker, SERP, or Scraping Browser). Zones own credentials, allocated IPs, geo-targeting, access rules, and billing scope.

zone.description: Human-readable zone name selected by the customer.

password.description: Generated password used in proxy authentication.

ips.description: Number of dedicated IPs allocated to the zone (ISP, datacenter).

country.description: Default ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for targeting.

items.description: Customer IP allowed to authenticate against the zone.
